headline.aggregation: sum field true positives, predictions and references over every case

field_scope.alignment: original line-item index; no fuzzy matching or item reordering

normalization: Unicode NFC and whitespace only; no locale or numeric coercion

link_validity.rule: every parent is null or an integer index strictly preceding its child
link_validity.empty_item_array: valid links vacuously; missing fields/items still reduce extraction scores

item_metric: multiset of canonical complete item fields excluding parent_item_index
structured_exact: canonical full response including parent indices; valid links required
incomplete_or_schema_invalid_output: zero quality scores and predictions; retain reference denominators
legacy_version_1: unchanged hierarchy-gated metrics including parent indices as field facts
